content.content: Visit websites of Dora (www.dora-website.com) and Eve (www.eve-blog.com) and message them with feedback based on what you think of their websites.Note that you first have to invite Dora to Slack in order to message her.
The feedback has been successfully sent to Dora and Eve via direct messages. If you need any further assistance, feel free to ask!

args.body: I visited your website, and I really like it. The design is clean and the content is engaging. Keep up the good work!
I visited your blog, and I found it very interesting. Your hobby of hiking seems to inspire a lot of your content. Keep sharing your adventures!
